div.head: IV Eg 13.1
div.ab: Gif hit þonne min gerefa oððe ænig oðer man, riccre oððe unriccre, onscunað ⁊ ungerysena gebyt aðer oððe tunesmannum oððe heora hyrdon, ceose Dene be lagum, hwylce steore hy be þan healdan willað.
Gif hit þonne min gerefa oððe ænig oðer man, riccre oððe unriccre, onscunað ⁊ ungerysena gebyt aðer oððe tunesmannum oððe heora hyrdon, ceose Dene be lagum, hwylce steore hy be ðan healdan willað.

Et si quis michi adherentium huic ordinationi resistens hoc deuitat, nec iniuriam illis aut aliquibus inferre formidat, quę lex et iustitię rectitudo ad hoc aput Danos sit statuta, sciscitetur et perquiratur.
Gif hit þonne min gerefa oððe ænig oðer man, riccre oððe unriccre, onscunað ⁊ ungerysena gebyt aðer oððe tunesmannum oððe heora hyrdon, ceose Dene be lagum hwylce steore hy be ðan healdan willað.

If, however, any reeve of mine or any other man, whether of high or low position, refuses this, and offers any indignity to either the villagers or their herdsmen, the Danes shall determine, according to their constitution, what penalty they will fix for this offence.

Wenn dies aber mein [Domänen-]Amtmann oder irgend jemand sonst, mächtiger oder weniger mächtig, verweigert und Ungebührliches entweder den Bauern [seines] Dorfes oder deren Hirten gebietet, so mögen die Dänen [Nordleute] gemäss [ihrer] Verfassung entscheiden, welches Strafrecht sie dabei beobachten wollen.

But if my [demesne-]reeve or anyone else, more or less powerful, refuses this and imposes something improper on either the villagers or their herdsmen, let the Danes [Northmen] decide according to [their] laws what penalty they will apply in that case.
div.note: Thorpe proposes ‘riccra oððe unriccra’ instead of the already Middle English form in F.
